name: Store Health Assistant
description: Daily WooCommerce store health digest with configurable alert thresholds.

options.label: Report recipient
options.description: Where the weekly health report is delivered.
options.help:
Enter one or more email addresses that should receive store health reports.
  • Separate multiple addresses with a comma.
  • Each address must be valid — bounced mail is silently dropped by your host.
  • Prefer a group mailbox (e.g. ops@…) so reports survive staff changes.

options.label: Low stock threshold
options.description: Products at or below this stock level are flagged.
options.help:
A product is reported as low stock when its remaining quantity is less than or equal to this number.
  • Use 0 to flag only out-of-stock items.
  • High-turnover stores typically set 5–10; slow luxury stores 1–2.

options.label: Send daily digest
options.description: Send a short summary every morning instead of only the weekly report.
options.help:
When enabled, a compact digest email arrives every day at 07:00 site time summarising overnight orders, low-stock products and failed webhooks.

Turn this off if you already watch the dashboard daily — too many emails is the #1 reason reports get ignored.
options.example: On for busy stores, Off for small shops

features: Once a day, collect order count/revenue for the last 24h, low-stock product count, and failed-payment count, then email the report_email address using the email-notify module and store a CSV snapshot via csv-export.
Expose a read-only REST endpoint (rest-api module) at /wp-json/store-health/v1/summary returning the same metrics as JSON for dashboard widgets, gated by the manage_woocommerce capability.
